records.name: Lest We Forget Slavery Museum
records.summary: A museum on Germantown Avenue about slavery and its legacy, with artifacts and a traveling exhibit for schools and venues. Visits are by appointment.
records.what_you_do: Visit the museum on a tour booked at least 24 hours ahead, or request the traveling exhibit for a school, venue or Black History program. Membership and donations are also offered.

schedule.text: Open Tuesday to Saturday 10 am to 4 pm and Sunday noon to 4 pm per the header, but tours are by appointment with 24 hours notice

cost.text: Not stated on the page we read

first_step.how: Call (215) 205-4324 or email info@lwfsm.com at least 24 hours ahead to book a tour
first_step.basis: Tours are open to the public, but only by appointment with notice

records.notes: Newest dated item on the site is 2016-09-27 (an interview). The site also asks for 2020 to 2021 Black History program requests with no date, so it may be out of date. The header hours conflict with the appointment-only tour policy; confirm by phone. Volunteering is not mentioned. Tag museum_volunteering is the closest museum tag, but the page is about visiting, not volunteering. Batch name is 'Lest We Forget Slavery Museum'; the site uses 'Lest We Forget Museum of Slavery'.

records.name: Network for New Music
records.summary: A Philadelphia ensemble that performs and commissions contemporary music, and runs an education program. Its season listings are the way in.
records.what_you_do: Attend concerts in its season, which includes the 2026 to 2027 season called Outside the Lines. Support the group through its annual fund or commissioning fund. The education section and volunteer roles are mentioned but not described.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket or attend a concert from the current season page at networkfornewmusic.org
first_step.basis: Concerts are public events listed on the season pages

records.notes: The site names the 2025 to 2026 season and an upcoming 2026 to 2027 season but shows no event dates, so status is probably_active. The contact details on the page are unfilled template text, so no phone or email is recorded. ensemble tag community_band is the closest music tag and is a placeholder. Newcomer friendliness not scored: no education details are published.

records.name: Wildflower Composers
records.summary: A mentoring program for early-career composers who are women, transgender, nonbinary or genderqueer. It runs a summer festival each July, in person at Temple University or online.
records.what_you_do: Apply to the annual summer festival, take virtual mini-courses, join the lab or get a resident composer placement, and follow the events page or mailing list.

schedule.text: An annual summer festival each July, plus virtual mini-courses and a lab

cost.text: Not stated on the page we read

first_step.how: Read the Festival page and apply during the open call, or sign up for the mailing list for updates
first_step.basis: Entry is by application and eligibility rules on the Contact and Festival pages

records.notes: No dated events are shown; status is probably_active because the site is working and describes an annual July festival. Volunteering is not mentioned. The email came from a mailto link on the site. Formerly Young Women Composers Camp, first season 2018. Tag instrument_lessons is the closest music tag for composition, and is a placeholder.

records.name: Bowerbird, INC.
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that presents music, dance and film, and runs synth classes and a free community synth studio.
records.what_you_do: Attend concerts and events, take synth classes, or use the free Community Synth Studio at AMLA and Esperanza. Support Bowerbird through its giving page.

schedule.text: Concerts and classes on listed dates in October and November 2026, and a free Community Synth Studio from October 21 to December 17, 2026

locations.label: Office (listed address; events are at other venues)

cost.text: Studio time is listed as free. Class and concert fees are not stated on the page we read

first_step.how: Go to the Community Synth Studio at AMLA or Esperanza during its run (October 21 to December 17, 2026), or sign up for the Intro to Synths class on October 20
first_step.basis: The studio says all experience levels are welcome, and the classes are open to the public

records.notes: Dated events from 2026-10-16 through 2026-12-17 on the events list. The published contact details are on the Contact page (not read), so no phone or email is recorded. Tag instrument_lessons is the closest tag for the synth courses. Concert categories are not sub-tagged.

records.name: Painted Bride Art Center, Inc.
records.summary: A contemporary art center with a 56-year history. It hosts exhibits, screenings, artist exchanges and a weekly Wednesday program called The Vibrary.
records.what_you_do: Attend events and screenings, join The Vibrary's weekly Wednesday sessions, or volunteer through the Volunteer page. The newsletter is the best way to stay informed.

schedule.text: Weekly Wednesday sessions of The Vibrary, plus events in fall 2026 including a capstone celebration on October 24 and November 5, 2026

cost.text: Not stated on the page we read

first_step.how: Come to a Wednesday Vibrary session, or fill in the Volunteer page form to help with events
first_step.basis: Events are open to the public and the site lists a clear way to volunteer

records.notes: The November 15, 2026 event (Black + Gold Artists Exchange) has its year inferred from the page. The batch lists the main address as 5212 Market Street; the site shows a Project Space at 4029 Cambridge Street, which is recorded here. Tag mural_public_art is a placeholder for a multidisciplinary art center.

records.name: Caribbean Festival and Cultural Organization of Pennsylvania Inc.
records.summary: Runs a free, family festival each August celebrating Caribbean culture with music, food, fashion and vendors, staffed by volunteers.
records.what_you_do: Attend the festival, volunteer on festival day through the volunteer page, or apply for the vendor booth or scholarship listed on the site.

schedule.text: The annual festival, held on a Sunday in August from noon to 8 pm

first_step.how: Go to the festival on the August Sunday at Cherry Street Pier, or send a volunteer inquiry through the site
first_step.basis: The festival is described as free and open to all, and the site invites new volunteers

records.notes: Newest date is the 40th annual festival on 2026-08-16 at Cherry Street Pier. An older page lists 2024 at Penn's Landing and is treated as outdated. The site shows two phone numbers, (215) 879-7948 and (215) 879-9352; the first is recorded. Vendor and scholarship pages are linked but not read.
